title: Shiv — Side Quest
description: Entertainment shelf: true crime, Why Files–style mystery, and comedy hangs (Brilliant Idiots, Flagrant, Conan when the guest is good). Not the intellectual Listen/Discover lane.
author: Shivanshu Chaudhary

items.title: Ben Lamm (on de-extinction) (Armchair Expert with Dax Shepard)
items.description:
Dax Shepard with Colossal Biosciences CEO Ben Lamm on building a company to bring back extinct species — mammoths, woolly mice, dire wolves — and why the real product may be the biotech along the way.

Watch: https://youtu.be/ElJciBYU6Eo

items.title: "Sharon Horgan" (SmartLess)
items.description:

items.title: Jared Diamond Returns (on the science of leadership) (Armchair Expert with Dax Shepard)
items.description:

Watch: https://youtu.be/JZKYOeE0x-o

items.title: Leanne Morgan (Armchair Expert with Dax Shepard)
